name: Article 12, § 6 – 198
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing an EU talent pool
part_text: 6. Participating Member States may decide, in the framework of the relevant Talent Partnership, to limit the visibility of profiles of registered jobseekers from third countries having obtained an ‘EU Talent Partnership pass’ to employers established in one or more Member States taking part in that same Talent Partnership. The EU Talent Pool Secretariat shall publish information on the application of this paragraph on the EU Talent Pool IT platform.
